name: Frank Worsley
contribution: A New Zealand sailor and explorer who served on Ernest Shackleton's Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition of 1914–1916, as captain of Endurance.

checks.lead: Frank Arthur Worsley  (22 February 1872 – 1 February 1943) was a New Zealand sailor and explorer who served on Ernest Shackleton's Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition of 1914–1916, as captain of  Endurance. He also served in the Royal Navy Reserve during the First World War.
